title: Lego Digital Play 收购《Chrome Valley Customs》开发商 Offroad Games
content:
Lego Digital Play snaps up Chrome Valley Customs maker Offroad Games – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Lego’s lowkey London-based mobile game studio has snapped up Offroad Games, the team behind Chrome Valley Customs.
We understand that Chrome Valley Customs will continue to operate under the Offroad Games label for now. The terms of the deal have not been disclosed at the time of writing.
It’s the first major public move from Lego Digital Play since its
formation back in early 2025
, when the toy giant spun up the the new mobile gaming-focused arm. The London-based outfit is led by president Aaron Loeb, a 30-year games industry veteran whose previous roles include leadership at Scopely, FoxNext Games and EA.
Offroad Games’ staff have all taken up roles at Lego Digital Play as of this morning, according to a flurry of LinkedIn posts.
The Chrome Valley Customs maker spun out of Space Ape
as part of the deal that saw
Supercell acquire the majority of the London studio back in 2025
.
That deal also saw
NextBeat spin out to run BeatStar
, which was then
acquired by Duolingo
. Space Ape cofounder John Earner is an adviser at Lego Digital Play.
“As of this week, we have joined Lego Digital Play which opens an incredibly exciting new chapter for us,”
said Offroad Games on LinkedIn
this morning. “A huge thank you to the Offroad team. You’re all superstars.”
“I also want to thank everyone who’s supported us in getting this far,” the post continued. “The people who believed in us when we spun out of Space Ape Games, the people who made the journey enjoyable through all its ups and downs, and everyone at Lego Digital Play for making us feel incredibly welcome.”
“And last but not least, to all the new teams out there: believe in your team, and believe that together you can move mountains. The journey is worth the ride!”
